array.string:
d="${DOTFILES_DIR:-$(for l in "$HOME/.zshrc" "$HOME/.agent/AGENTS.md" "$HOME/.claude/settings.json"; do t=$(readlink "$l" 2>/dev/null) || continue; r=$(cd "$(dirname "$t")/.." 2>/dev/null && pwd) || continue; [ -d "$r/scripts" ] && printf %s "$r" && break; done)}" [ -n "$d" ] || { echo "doctor: dotfiles checkout not found" >&2; exit 1; } log="${XDG_STATE_HOME:-$HOME/.local/state}/dotfiles" mkdir -p "$log" out=$(cd "$d" && bash scripts/doctor.sh 2>&1); status=$? { printf '
===== %s (exit %s) =====
' "$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)" "$status"; printf '%s
' "$out"; } >> "$log/doctor.log" bad=$(printf '%s
' "$out" | grep -cE '^(warn|fail)' || true) if [ "$status" -ne 0 ] || [ "${bad:-0}" -gt 0 ]; then osascript -e "display notification "$bad warn/fail - see $log/doctor.log" with title "dotfiles doctor"" 2>/dev/null || true fi exit 0
